products.description: The PUMA ForeverRun NITRO is a high-performance running shoe designed for support and stability. It features a black engineered mesh upper and a lime green NITRO foam midsole with dual densities—a softer core and a firmer rim—to provide cushioning without compromising stability. The shoe is detailed with a bronze accent on the heel, a lime green pull tab, and a white outsole with a wider medial rubber segment to help stabilize late-stage pronation.

key_features: Dual-density NITRO midsole (softer core, firmer rim)

products.description: The PUMA MagMax NITRO is a high-performance men's running shoe designed for neutral pronators. The PUMAGRIP outsole ensures superior traction and protects the foam midsole, making it an ideal choice for road running and athletic activities.

products.description: A sculpted cage and textured mesh upper give the Women's Voltra Running Shoe an effortlessly cool athletic look. Designed for performance and style, these running shoes feature a round toe, lace-up closure, and convenient pull tabs on the tongue and heel for easy on-and-off. The interior is designed for comfort with a padded collar, tongue, and smooth lining with a cushioned insole. For enhanced support and shock absorption, they are equipped with a SOFTFOAM+ midsole and a durable rubber outsole for reliable traction.

products.description: Experience enhanced performance and bold style with the Men's Puma Amplifier Running Shoes. Designed for both the track and the streets, these shoes offer responsive cushioning and a lightweight, supportive feel. Featuring a breathable mesh upper with synthetic and rubber overlays, a sleek white stripe detail, and a durable rubber sole with a reinforced toe cap, these sneakers provide comfort and swagger. The SOFTFOAM+ sockliner ensures soft cushioning, while the flexible midsole allows for smooth transitions. Pull tabs on the heel and tongue make for easy on and off.
